personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Tech Cyber Gold Theme Fusion
personality_one_liner: A premium, unified competitions ecosystem fusing clean iOS layout structures with a Tech Cyber Gold identity for an immersive e-commerce experience.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Utilize safe area insets at bottom for sticky banners. Keep inputs and buttons minimum 44pt height.

do's: Use on customer sticky floating banner at the bottom of the Home feed.
Use on floating action buttons (FABs) like the 'Create Video' button.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrim over hero background images.
dont's: Don't use on body form fields.
Don't use on dense lists or standard merchant views.

screens.name: MerchantNewCompetition
screens.purpose: Single flow for merchants to create any of the 3 competition types.
screens.layout: Dark theme layout (merchantSurface #0A0A0A). Top: segmented control or 3 horizontal scrollable cards to pick Type (Purchase / Q&A / UGC). Below: Dynamic form. Purchase: threshold input, single/accumulated toggle. Q&A: question input, add option rows (check correct). UGC: Submissions cap, winner count. Sticky bottom Primary CTA 'Create Competition'.

screens.name: CustomerHome
screens.purpose: Home feed featuring a sticky floating banner for active competitions.
screens.layout: Standard white e-commerce feed. Bottom sticky banner (glassmorphism enabled) anchored above tab bar. Left side: Context (Prize icon + 'اشتري بـ 1000 ر.س وادخل السحب على iPhone 15'). Right side: small circular progress pie or secondary CTA 'انضم الآن'. Must preserve space via safe-area-inset.

screens.name: CustomerPurchaseDetail
screens.purpose: Shows user progress towards a purchase-based competition.
screens.layout: Hero image of prize with dark scrim and title. Large animated ProgressBar component in center showing accumulated spend vs threshold. Subtitle 'متبقي 350 ر.س للانضمام'. Info cards for rules. Sticky 'Shop Now' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: CustomerQnADetail
screens.purpose: User answers a quiz to enter the draw.
screens.layout: Prize hero image. Large bold question text. Vertical list of AnswerOption cards. On tap, animate border and apply subtle glow if correct, then slide up a success bottom sheet confirming entry.

screens.name: CustomerUGCDetail
screens.purpose: UGC video competition featuring live leaderboard and video upload.

states.empty: Illustration + 'كن أول من يشارك بفيديو!' (Be the first to submit a video!)

screens.layout: Top: Campaign hero + CountdownTimer component pulsing red in last hour. Middle: 'LeaderboardRow' list sorted by likes. Top 1-3 highlighted with leaderboardGoldGradient tokens. Each row has thumbnail, name, rank badge, like count, LikeButton. Bottom right: Sticky FAB 'إنشاء فيديو' with glass effect.

screens.name: CustomerUGCSubmit
screens.purpose: Form to upload a user-generated video for the competition.
screens.layout: Full screen form. Large VideoUploadButton (dashed border area) using ImagePicker. Inputs for caption and hashtags. Sticky 'Submit Video' bottom button.

screens.name: ChamberDrawOverview
screens.purpose: Supervisory view for Chamber employees to execute final draws.
screens.layout: Dark theme layout (merchantSurface #0A0A0A). List of supervised competitions ready for draw. Card shows permit number, participants count. Action button 'إجراء السحب' triggers draw and opens video upload modal for ceremonial announcement.

screens.name: CompetitionsTab
screens.purpose: Central hub for all competition history and active statuses.
screens.layout: Header with 4 segmented tabs (نشطة / قادمة / منتهية / فائزون). List of CompetitionCards. Winners section features video player (draw videos) and winner names.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL THEME INSTRUCTION: The user strictly requested 'Tech Cyber Gold' (#0A0A0A and #F5C518). Implement the Merchant and Chamber screens in DARK mode using the 'merchantSurface' (#0A0A0A) and 'merchantSurfaceSecondary' tokens. Implement the Customer screens in LIGHT mode (white surface, subtle gold accents).

UGC Leaderboard Architecture: Ensure the leaderboard list features rank badges. The top 3 rows should have a distinct gold gradient background or border utilizing the 'leaderboardGoldGradientStart/End' tokens.

Customer Home Banner: The floating banner for purchase competitions must be sticky at the bottom. Use absolute positioning with bottom mapped to the safe area inset. Apply 'expo-glass-effect' for the banner container background so the feed content blurs underneath it.

Interaction & Animation: Add reanimated shared values to smoothly fill the ProgressBar on the CustomerPurchaseDetail screen. On CustomerQnADetail, when the correct AnswerOption is tapped, animate the border color to 'success' (#10B981) and trigger a soft haptic success feedback.
State Flows: For Q&A, the entry is immediate upon a correct answer. For Purchase, entry happens automatically once the spend threshold is met. For UGC, the entry is manual via the video upload form.
Add new components: `CompetitionCard`, `ProgressBar`, `AnswerOption`, `LeaderboardRow`, `CountdownTimer`, `VideoUploadButton`, `LikeButton` to the UI kit.
API Integrations: Introduce mocked API endpoints for UGC (`/competitions/{cid}/videos` POST/GET, `/competitions/{cid}/videos/{vid}/like` POST, `/competitions/{cid}/leaderboard`).
Empty states: Ensure all empty states display an appropriate illustration alongside Arabic text, centered with a Call to Action if applicable.
